name: whitenoise
setup: 🐞 SCENARIO: white noise heron. Static on the water, three tiles east. Do not listen too long.
log: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 2). The debris hut: ridgepole, ribs, 2 feet of leaves. Survived -40° in testing. Really.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 1 skill from your past — check your Journal.
Nothing here looks like home. You know none of these plants. Learn fast.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Fatima Brooks. Roofer. From Minneapolis, USA. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Hard Candy, Mixtape, Carpenter's square, Home key, Knife roll. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
A woman, maybe 20s: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
🐞 SCENARIO: white noise heron. Static on the water, three tiles east. Do not listen too long.
It unfolds to its full height. The air goes staticky. Leave the creek.
🐦 It moves.
You don't know what that was. a heron that isn't quite there when you look at it Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ A HERON THAT ISN'T QUITE THERE WHEN YOU LOOK AT IT! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
(heron that isn't quite there when you look at it's hide absorbs 1.)
You STRIKE the heron that isn't quite there when you look at it for 26 (Fire-hardened spear).
It unfolds further — impossibly tall. The air goes staticky; the creek goes flat. It has decided.
(heron that isn't quite there when you look at it's hide absorbs 1.)
You STRIKE the heron that isn't quite there when you look at it for 30 (Fire-hardened spear).
The heron that isn't quite there when you look at it falls.

Fishy. Obviously. Everything about it is fishy. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
You clutch your Hard Candy, Mixtape, Carpenter's square, Home key, Knife roll. You're still here.
